description: Search Trade Me Property residential listings for sale or rent across New Zealand, or refresh specific listings. No account, cookies or API key required.

district.description: Narrow the search to one district, for example Auckland City or Christchurch City. Enter a district name or Trade Me district ID.
district.title: District (optional)

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full listing page data for each result. Adds the description, every photo, agent names and property features, at the cost of one extra request per listing.
includeDetails.title: Load full details for every search result

listingUrls.description: Trade Me Property listing URLs or numeric listing IDs. Used when mode is Refresh specific listing URLs.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs or IDs

maxBathrooms.description: Largest number of bathrooms to include.
maxBathrooms.title: Maximum bathrooms

maxBedrooms.description: Largest number of bedrooms to include.
maxBedrooms.title: Maximum bedrooms

maxFloorArea.description: Largest floor area in square metres.
maxFloorArea.title: Maximum floor area (m²)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to save. Trade Me serves up to 50 per page; the actor walks pages until it reaches this limit or the source is exhausted.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

maxLandArea.description: Largest land area in square metres.
maxLandArea.title: Maximum land area (m²)

maxLounges.description: Largest number of separate lounges or living areas.
maxLounges.title: Maximum living areas

maxParking.description: Largest number of garage, carport or off-street parking spaces.
maxParking.title: Maximum parking spaces

maxPrice.description: Highest asking price for sale listings, or highest weekly rent for rental listings.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price or weekly rent (NZD)

minBathrooms.description: Smallest number of bathrooms to include.
minBathrooms.title: Minimum bathrooms

minBedrooms.description: Smallest number of bedrooms to include. Use 0 to include studios.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms

minFloorArea.description: Smallest floor area in square metres.
minFloorArea.title: Minimum floor area (m²)

minLandArea.description: Smallest land area in square metres.
minLandArea.title: Minimum land area (m²)

minLounges.description: Smallest number of separate lounges or living areas.
minLounges.title: Minimum living areas

minParking.description: Smallest number of garage, carport or off-street parking spaces.
minParking.title: Minimum parking spaces

minPrice.description: Lowest asking price for sale listings, or lowest weekly rent for rental listings.
minPrice.title: Minimum price or weekly rent (NZD)

mode.description: Search residential properties for sale, search rental listings, or refresh a list of property URLs you already track.
mode.title: What to scrape

openHomesOnly.description: Return only properties that have an upcoming open home.
openHomesOnly.title: Only listings with open homes

propertyType.description: Limit results to one type of property.
propertyType.title: Property type

region.description: New Zealand region to search. Choose All New Zealand to search nationwide.
region.title: Region

salesMethod.description: Only return sale listings using this method. Ignored for rental searches.
salesMethod.title: Sale method

searchString.description: Only return listings whose title or description matches this keyword, for example villa, waterfront or garage.
searchString.title: Keyword (optional)

suburb.description: Narrow the search to one suburb, for example Ponsonby or Riccarton. Enter a suburb name or Trade Me suburb ID.
suburb.title: Suburb (optional)

title: Trade Me Property Scraper Input
